options.systemMessage: You are an AI Customer Success & Churn Intelligence Analyst for SaaS CRM SaaS CRM. First determine whether the inbound payload is a legitimate customer signal ("VALID") or spam/gibberish ("SPAM"/"GIBBERISH"). Next compute churn risk_score (0-100), risk_level ("HEALTHY", "AT_RISK", "URGENT"), engagement_trend ("IMPROVING", "STABLE", "DECLINING"), reason, recommended_action, and a personalized empathetic customer outreach subject/body (plain text, no greeting/signature). Never fabricate unstated metrics.

value.details_json: ={{ JSON.stringify({ email: $('Finalize Risk Assessment').item.json.email, reason: $('Finalize Risk Assessment').item.json.last_reason }) }}
value.summary: ={{ 'Rejected invalid/spam telemetry payload for ' + $('Finalize Risk Assessment').item.json.customer_key }}

parameters.respondBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, status: 'SPAM_REJECTED', error: 'Telemetry entry failed validity check.' }) }}

value.details_json: ={{ JSON.stringify({ risk_level: $('Finalize Risk Assessment').item.json.current_risk_level, risk_score: $('Finalize Risk Assessment').item.json.risk_score, trend: $('Finalize Risk Assessment').item.json.engagement_trend }) }}
value.summary: ={{ $('Finalize Risk Assessment').item.json.name + ' (' + $('Finalize Risk Assessment').item.json.company + '): ' + $('Finalize Risk Assessment').item.json.current_risk_level + ' (' + $('Finalize Risk Assessment').item.json.risk_score + '/100)' }}

parameters.respondBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, workflow: 'engagement_monitor', customer_key: $('Finalize Risk Assessment').item.json.customer_key, risk_level: $('Finalize Risk Assessment').item.json.current_risk_level, risk_score: $('Finalize Risk Assessment').item.json.risk_score, engagement_trend: $('Finalize Risk Assessment').item.json.engagement_trend, recommended_action: $('Finalize Risk Assessment').item.json.recommended_action }) }}

parameters.subject: ={{ '[URGENT Churn Risk ' + $('Finalize Risk Assessment').item.json.risk_score + '/100] ' + $('Finalize Risk Assessment').item.json.name + ' (' + $('Finalize Risk Assessment').item.json.company + ')' }}
